regression_before_fix.reason: Different incoming VCs were interleaved after mapping to the same output VC. RouterStation now retains ownership per output direction and next-hop VC until the packet tail.

vc_mapping_regression_before_fix.reason: An ordinary p2p transfer was mapped onto VC3 reserved for streaming FC13 reduction, causing a packet ownership dependency. The exporter maps ordinary VC3 traffic to VC0 and updates TSRTAB consistently.
